identity_selection: Unused IDs in previous Aug14/Aug19/Aug20 intersection, ranked by SHA256(cow-id-training-v1-26:+ID); all four held-out roles mutually disjoint and outside all40 IDs of the prior feature pilot
sampling: Uniform indices over sorted camera1 filenames including endpoints; retain all if training directory has fewer than10; whole identity excluded for insufficient required sources; no post-score replacement

conditions.name: A_official_frozen
conditions.preprocess: Official resize256 centre crop224 ImageNet normalisation

conditions.name: B_letterbox_frozen
conditions.preprocess: Keep aspect, contain within224 square, centre pad RGB127, ImageNet normalisation

conditions.name: C_letterbox_trained
conditions.encoder: Fine-tune same576dim encoder on training IDs only; classifier used only for training

optimisation.sampling: Seeded uniform8 training IDs per batch; four distinct images per ID covering at least2dates
optimisation.loss: Cross entropy of16x cosine-normalised class logits + batch-hard Euclidean triplet, margin0.3, unit embeddings
optimisation.training_augmentation: Random mirror p0.5, rotation uniform[-8,8] expand with RGB127, ColorJitter brightness0.2 contrast0.2 saturation0.1, then letterbox224
optimisation.checkpoint_selection: Per seed select epoch with highest validation correctly-accepted registered queries at empirical unknown FAR<=0.05; ties minimise registered wrong accepts, then higher closed Top1, then earliest epoch

retrieval: Max cosine per registered identity across5 references, then best identity; gallery identities differ between validation and evaluation
calibration: Each model/seed threshold from validation registered and unknown queries only, same selection rule as previous pilot. Freeze threshold and checkpoints for all three seeds before any evaluation-feature forward pass
evaluation: All A/B/threeC conditions share the same previously unused evaluation identities/images; report individual seeds and paired per-identity differences B-to-C, not a selected best seed
statistics: Identity-cluster bootstrap seed26 draws2000; boundary all-zero error reported with counts and small-cohort limitation, not a zero population bound
integrity: Full decode, byte/pixel hashes, forbid exact duplicate pixels across roles; record within-train duplicates; compare per-ID model outcomes, preserve all negative results
scope: Small identity-disjoint, cross-day, curated-crop development study on one camera and farm. Final evaluation IDs never enter gradient updates, checkpoint/threshold choice or quantisation calibration; not whole-passage/RF/PYNQ measurement
